narrative: In the account book. A sheet of the week's share, the new line just wet. No sum ruled underneath. John's hand is at the edge of the sheet, not writing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the share and did not rule a total.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Stood by the line and did not ask for a second figure.

entities.name: 38s
entities.context: Shown on ledger in The share, and nothing under it
